stories.title: US Prepares Major Sanctions Against Iran Amidst Threats of Retaliation
stories.summary: The US is set to announce new economic sanctions against Iran, described by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent as the 'greatest financial offensive ever marshaled.' This initiative, termed 'economic D-Day' by the Trump administration, aims to isolate Iran economically and target its trade partners. In response, Iran has threatened to retaliate against any nation that supports these sanctions, calling such actions an 'act of war.'

stories.title: Landslide at Guinea Landfill Claims 31 Lives
stories.summary: A landslide at a major landfill site in Conakry, Guinea, has resulted in the deaths of at least 31 people. The incident occurred after heavy rains caused a mound of rubbish to collapse, burying nearby homes and tents. This disaster follows recent government announcements regarding plans to relocate the waste site due to safety concerns, particularly during the rainy season.

stories.title: Dutch Broadcaster AVROTROS to Boycott Eurovision 2027 Over Neutrality Concerns
stories.summary: Dutch broadcaster AVROTROS has announced its decision to boycott the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, citing concerns that the event can no longer be considered neutral due to escalating international conflicts, particularly the war in Gaza. This marks the second time the Netherlands has opted out of the competition for similar reasons.

stories.title: U.S. Marines Cancel Joint Drills with South Korea Due to Iran War Constraints
stories.summary: The U.S. Marines have canceled a planned joint military drill with South Korea, citing force constraints related to the ongoing Iran war. This decision was communicated in June, following President Trump's recent order to reduce the duration of another military exercise, the Ulchi Freedom Shield, from 11 days to five. The cancellation reflects adjustments in U.S. military commitments amid international conflicts.

stories.title: DR Congo and M23 Rebels Establish Roadmap for Peace Talks
stories.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo and the M23 rebels have reached an agreement on a roadmap for peace talks, following a history of conflict in the eastern region. This agreement aims to outline the next steps and timetable for negotiations under the Doha framework, which had previously stalled amid ongoing violence. The U.S. State Department acted as a mediator in this process.

stories.title: European Leaders Gather in Kyiv for Ukraine's Independence Day Amid Ongoing Russian Invasion
stories.summary: On August 24, European leaders joined President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv to celebrate Ukraine's Independence Day, coinciding with the ongoing Russian invasion that has persisted for four years. This event marked a significant show of solidarity from European nations as they continue to support Ukraine during the conflict.

stories.title: Kushner and Jeffries Meet Ahead of Midterm Elections
stories.summary: Jared Kushner met with Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries in New York City to discuss potential cooperation between Democrats and Trump as the midterm elections approach. The meeting comes as control of the House is at stake in the upcoming November elections, with Democrats expected to gain an advantage. Topics discussed included housing, immigration, and the rising cost of living.

stories.title: Zelensky Opposes Wartime Elections, Citing Risks for Ukraine
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has rejected calls for wartime elections, stating that such a move would be highly dangerous and could split the country. His comments follow a proposal from former defense minister Mykhailo Fedorov, who was recently dismissed. A recent poll indicated that only 15% of Ukrainians support holding elections during the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Wildfire Forces Evacuations in Reno, Nevada, as Homes Are Destroyed
stories.summary: A fast-moving wildfire in northwest Reno, Nevada, has prompted authorities to urge the evacuation of approximately 90,000 residents. The fire, which has destroyed homes and complicated firefighting efforts due to shifting winds, has also endangered first responders and civilians. Fire crews are struggling to control the blaze as it jumps over fire trucks and creates hazardous conditions.

The race presented unique challenges due to its unconventional route through the National Mall.

stories.title: Iran Unveils Significant Natural Gas Discovery Amid Energy Sector Challenges
stories.summary: Iran has announced the discovery of over 200 billion cubic meters of natural gas in the southern Fars province, with more than 160 billion cubic meters potentially recoverable. This announcement comes as the country grapples with disruptions in its energy sector due to ongoing US-Israeli strikes on gas facilities and oil transport routes. The find is significant as Tehran faces increasing pressure regarding its oil export capabilities.

stories.title: Iran's Rial Hits Record Low Amid Upcoming US Sanctions
stories.summary: Iran's currency, the rial, has reached a new record low, trading at 2.02 million rials to the U.S. dollar. This decline occurs as the United States is set to announce additional sanctions against Iran. The official Central Bank rate is approximately 1.5 million rials to the dollar, but the market rate reflects the price most Iranians encounter.
